assertion_review.fails_if: The fixture does not create a pointer with a distinct attempt identity; this is a setup precondition, not the regression guard.
Finishing does not report finished after a newer pointer is written during merge.
Finishing selects a revision different from the actual Git repair commit; the expected SHA is independently read from Git by the shared helper.
The repaired head is absent from remote main or the independently checked combined source-content marker is missing.
Pointer retirement ignores the attempt comparison and removes the newer pointer; negative-newer.log demonstrates this exact failure.

Finishing alters any persisted newer-pointer field or replaces its identity; runs.read_pointer rereads the on-disk file after the real merge, so this is a preservation invariant rather than an echoed argument assertion.
Finishing removes the newer attempt worktree directory.
The preserved directory no longer resolves to the actual repaired Git commit.
Finishing unregisters the newer attempt worktree even if the directory remains.
Successful integration leaves the pending landing record behind.
